nodes.label: i18n (i18next + react-i18next)
nodes.rationale: useSuspense is disabled because React Native has no Suspense boundary; every locale key must exist in every locale, enforced by a parity test.

nodes.label: SQLite schema and tables
nodes.rationale: DDL lives in src/db/schema.ts and is versioned via PRAGMA user_version to support local migrations.

nodes.label: Privacy-first hard constraint
nodes.rationale: No auth, no cloud sync, no analytics/tracking libraries, no external APIs; all data persists locally in SQLite to guarantee data ownership and privacy.
